title: Odile and the Orbit
author: Marguerite Okonkwo
blurb: Tamsin Almeida, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
